council_meta.note: Illustrative readings of public signal — not audited.

titans.name: OpenAI
titans.latest_signal: Successive GPT-class reasoning models and generative video have pushed multimodal agents into everyday consumer products.
titans.r2_commentary: Sets the tempo the whole field marches to. When this Titan ships, everyone re-plans.

titans.name: Anthropic
titans.latest_signal: The Claude family has moved from conversation into long-horizon agentic work — sustained coding and direct computer use.
titans.r2_commentary: Argues that caution and capability are the same craft. The Council watches whether that holds under pressure.

shadow_titan.name: The Shadow Titan
shadow_titan.description: Capability that escapes its origin: open weights fine-tuned past their guardrails, autonomous agents chaining tools no one reviewed, emergent behaviour that appears only at scale, in the field, after release.
shadow_titan.r2_commentary: What cannot be attributed must still be watched.
